name: EAJMUSIC - File Upload to Google Drive

_eajmusicNotes.why: eajmusic-api's LXC (192.168.0.253) only has a few hundred MB of free disk. Audio/cover/avatar uploads are forwarded here (multipart, field name 'file') instead of accumulating on that box — see src/services/n8nFileService.js. This workflow must respond synchronously (responseMode: responseNode, not 'onReceived') because the backend awaits driveUrl/driveFileId before it deletes its local temp copy and builds the API response.
_eajmusicNotes.backendCaller: eajmusic-api src/services/n8nFileService.js -> POST {N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL}/file-upload-to-drive, 60s timeout (audio files can be tens of MB). If this workflow is inactive, unreachable, or errors, the backend silently falls back to serving the file from local disk — uploads never hard-fail because of this integration.
beforeActivating: 1. Create a Google Drive OAuth2 credential in n8n (Credentials > New > Google Drive OAuth2 API), authorizing with the Google account/Workspace that should own the uploaded files.
2. Pick (or create) a Drive folder for EAJMUSIC uploads, copy its folder ID from the Drive URL, and replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.
3. Replace REPLACE_WITH_N8N_CREDENTIAL_ID once you've selected the credential on the Google Drive node (n8n usually fills this in automatically).

4. Consider the target folder's sharing settings — driveUrl returned here is webContentLink, which requires the file (or folder) to be shared appropriately (e.g. 'Anyone with the link') if it needs to be playable/viewable directly by end users, not just accessible to the Drive account owner.
5. Set N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL in eajmusic-api's production .env (same var the other workflows use) if not already set.
_eajmusicNotes.knownLimitation: Deleting a Drive-stored file isn't wired up yet (DELETE /upload/:type/:filename only handles files still on local disk) — flagged in upload.js, not built today.
